entities.summary: Lars Gule is a Norwegian philosopher. He has graduated with a doctorate in philosophy, and is an associate professor. From 2000 to 2005 he was secretary general of the Norwegian Humanist Association. Gule became known to the general public in 1977 when after having joined the DFLP group, Gule was arrested in Beirut, Lebanon with Semtex in his luggage intended for Israeli targets leading to a six-month conviction and subsequent deportation. He remains active as a anti-Israel activist. Gule is often used by Norwegian media as an authority on questions regarding the Middle East, Islam and extremism.

historicalSignificance.significanceNarrative: Lars Gule's arrest in Beirut and subsequent conviction for possessing Semtex led to a six-month sentence and deportation. His experiences as an anti-Israel activist have made him a prominent voice on Middle Eastern issues in Norway.
